node.statement: Apply lem-maincb-stage3-raw-merge to the explicit datum: its source is B_U oplus B_V with finite-dimensional C*-algebra summands, its target is A_R, its four maps are bijective, and 0<=rho<=C_cross^0*t_3 with 0<=epsilon_R<=t_3<=W.e_cross. Using the same fixed witnesses, the Stage-3 producer conclusion packaged in lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger names the resulting literal map u_3:B_U oplus B_V->A_R and gives that it is an extended D_*t_3-isomorphism with ||u_3(I_{B_U oplus B_V})-u_{A_R}||<=D_*t_3.
